newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dow depresses Belgian shares but Bekaert shines.
newsitem.headline: Dow depresses Belgian shares but Bekaert shines.

text.p: 0830 GMT - Belgian shares depressed at the start by the Dow's 42-point drop overnight with firmer dollar and bonds unable to prop up prices.
* Bel-20 index .BFX down 0.35 percent, or 8.19 points, at 2,339.36
* Steel wire and cord maker Bekaert among leading gainers, up 2.8 percent at 22,750.
